body:
Updates the Oceananigans compat to `0.116` and bumps ClimaSeaIce to 0.6.1.

Oceananigans 0.115 ([CliMA/Oceananigans.jl#6275](https://github.com/CliMA/Oceananigans.jl/pull/6275)) builds topologies per side with `Sides{L, R}` and removes `LeftConnected`, `RightConnected`, `FullyConnected` and the `LeftConnectedRight*` names. The only place ClimaSeaIce used them is `ConnectedTopology` in the split-explicit momentum solver, which decides whether to extend the halos of a distributed grid. It becomes

```julia
const ConnectedTopology = Union{Sides{Connected}, Sides{Closed, Connected}, RightCenterFolded, RightFaceFolded}
```

which contains exactly the nine topologies of the old union (checked on 0.116.1) and still excludes `Bounded`, `Periodic` and `Flat`. It keeps the folded topologies, unlike Oceananigans' own `ConnectedTopology` for the ocean's split-explicit free surface.

Support for Oceananigans 0.114 is dropped because the `Sides` names don't exist there. Nothing else in the 0.115 and 0.116 breaking changes touches ClimaSeaIce.

This unblocks NumericalEarth moving to Oceananigans 0.116.
